BiblicalUsage: Shilshah is the son of Zophah. He is named among the mighty men of Asher in the genealogy of the tribe.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a mighty man of Asher is worth naming, and Shilshah's single verse names him.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
